title: The delayed website
situation: Martin's Bakery, a small family business, expected its new website on Monday. The photos arrived late, so the launch moves to next Friday.
goal: Get the AI to draft the email that tells them.

role.placeholder: e.g. An account manager at a web agency

details.label: Who the AI should be
details.hint: Who should the AI be? Give it a job, like an account manager at a web agency.

task.placeholder: e.g. Write an email to the client

details.label: Write an email
details.hint: What should it produce? Say it plainly: write an email to the client.

context.placeholder: e.g. Who the client is, what happened, the new date

details.label: The client's name
details.hint: Who is the client? The AI can't guess it's Martin's Bakery.

details.label: Why it's late
details.hint: Why is it late? Mention the photos that arrived late.

details.label: The new date
details.hint: When will it be ready? Give the new date: next Friday.

format.placeholder: e.g. Friendly and apologetic, under 120 words

details.label: The tone
details.hint: What tone? Friendly and apologetic works well for bad news.

details.label: The length
details.hint: How long should it be? For example: under 120 words.

example.placeholder: e.g. A sentence in the tone you like

details.label: An example to follow
details.hint: Bonus: show a sentence in the tone you like, so the AI can copy the style.

details.label: A rule to respect
details.hint: Bonus: add a rule, like don't blame the client.

conflicts.explain: Short and detailed at the same time? The AI can't do both. Pick one length.

answers.vague:
Dear customer,

We would like to inform you about an update regarding your project. There may be some changes to the timeline. We will keep you informed.

Best regards
answers.passable:
Dear customer,

We are writing to let you know that your website has been delayed. We apologise for any inconvenience and will let you know the new date as soon as possible.

Best regards,
The web team
answers.excellent:
Hi Martin's Bakery team,

Quick update on your new website: the launch is moving from this Monday to next Friday. The photos reached us a little later than planned, and we want them to look their best on your pages.

Sorry for the wait. We'll send you a preview link on Wednesday so you can see everything before it goes live.

Warm regards,
Your account manager

ada.intro: First mission: a client email with bad news. Fill in the four blocks, then press Build & test to see if your prompt holds.
ada.success: It holds! Every block is solid stone, so the AI wrote exactly the email you needed.
ada.takeaway: Context turns a generic email into the right one: who, why and when.
